research_notes: Blocked for headline calculation: official biography, member and party biographies plus independent appointment coverage do not establish a dated full-time nonpolitical employment history.

Searched Basem Abdo biography, work history and employment dates with both search engines on 2026-09-12. No usable dated public professional profile found. Saudi engineering/research profiles with the same name refer to a different person and were rejected.
Teaching study is not evidence that he worked as a teacher. Need named employer, dates and full-time status before either sector can be counted.
No omitted occupation is treated as zero; political staff and federal elected office are excluded under project rules.

2026-10-01: recovered full first speech and added previously missing teenage car-washing job. Split Vamvakinou employment into two undated periods on employer-interview reporting, preserving the unknown break. No private/public duration or full-time status inferred. Original study-only caution still applies: school’s recent public reference to teaching experience is a lead, not a dated paid teaching spell.
